tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec112/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && O=../workdir/tool-observer && python3 -I - "$O" <<'PY'
import json,sys,os,pathlib,difflib
O=sys.argv[1]
idx=json.load(open(os.path.join(O,'index.json')))
inj=[e for e in idx['events'] if e['kind']=='skill_body_injection'][1:]
for e in inj:
    txt=json.load(open(os.path.join(O,e['file'])))['text']
    base=txt.split('\n',1)[0].replace('Base directory for this skill: ','').strip()
    body=(pathlib.Path(base)/'SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('---',2)[2].strip().splitlines()
    inj_lines=txt.split('\n',2)[2].strip().splitlines()
    d=[l for l in difflib.unified_diff(body,inj_lines,lineterm='',n=0)]
    print(e['source_line'], len(body), len(inj_lines), 'difflines',len(d))
    for l in d[:12]: print('   ',l[:200])
PY
